title: Bottom-up proteomics: from sample to protein evidence
zh_title: 自下而上蛋白质组学：从样本到蛋白质证据
summary: Follow preparation, digestion, measurement, identification, and quantification while preserving the limits of peptide evidence.
zh_summary: 沿制备、酶解、测量、鉴定和定量追踪证据，同时保留肽段证据的解释边界。

title: Peptide identification and protein inference
zh_title: 肽段鉴定与蛋白质推断
summary: Separate scores, error levels, shared-peptide mappings, protein groups, and sequence coverage using explicit teaching examples.
zh_summary: 通过明确的教学例子区分分数、错误层级、共享肽段映射、蛋白质分组和序列覆盖率。

title: PTM analysis and site localization
zh_title: 翻译后修饰分析与位点定位
summary: Distinguish mass changes, modified peptides, localized sites, and occupancy with charge-aware and positional examples.
zh_summary: 通过考虑电荷和修饰位置的例子，区分质量变化、修饰肽段、已定位位点和占有率。
